studies.label: Human knee-pain case series

source.title: Intra-Articular Injection of BPC 157 for Multiple Types of Knee Pain

sentences: Sixteen patients were contacted after knee injections; eleven of twelve receiving BPC-157 alone reported improvement.
The study had no control group or objective confirmation of tissue repair.

studies.label: Human bladder-pain case series

source.title: Effect of BPC-157 on Symptoms in Patients with Interstitial Cystitis: A Pilot Study

sentences: Ten of twelve women reported complete symptom resolution after bladder injections, and two reported partial improvement.
There was no control group, and questionnaire timing is described inconsistently.

studies.label: Human intravenous safety pilot

source.title: Safety of Intravenous Infusion of BPC157 in Humans: A Pilot Study

sentences: Two previously exposed adults underwent three days of laboratory and symptom monitoring, with no adverse effects reported by the authors.
This was not a pharmacokinetic study and cannot establish long-term safety.

studies.label: Animal pharmacokinetics

source.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

sentences: Reported mean half-lives of intact BPC-157 were below thirty minutes in the tested rat and dog regimens.
These findings do not establish a human half-life or dosing interval.

studies.label: Human clinical-note study · Preprint

source.title: Rising Use of Unapproved BPC-157 (“Wolverine Peptide”) and Associated Patient-Reported Outcomes Curated from Clinical Notes
source.kind: Primary research · Preprint, not peer reviewed

sentences: This unreviewed preprint identified 1,039 documented users, with response direction missing for 685.
Missing outcomes, co-treatments and an absent control group prevent a treatment-effect estimate.

studies.label: Tendon-cell growth hormone receptors

source.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

sentences: BPC-157 increased growth-hormone receptor expression in cultured rat tendon fibroblasts.
Receptor expression in a culture does not demonstrate higher circulating growth hormone in people.

studies.label: Rat muscle-to-bone reattachment

source.title: Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 as Therapy After Surgical Detachment of the Quadriceps Muscle from Its Attachments for Muscle-to-Bone Reattachment in Rats

sentences: The investigators reported improved quadriceps reattachment and walking after experimentally detaching muscle from bone.
The oral rat regimen does not establish human oral absorption or recovery.

studies.label: Rat muscle–tendon junction injury

source.title: Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 as a Therapy for the Disable Myotendinous Junctions in Rats

sentences: The investigators reported functional and muscle-size recovery after separating the muscle–tendon junction in rats.
This surgical model does not establish recovery from human sports injuries.

studies.label: Rat muscle injury with corticosteroids

source.title: Impact of pentadecapeptide BPC 157 on muscle healing impaired by systemic corticosteroid application

sentences: BPC-157 improved measured healing after rat muscle crush during methylprednisolone exposure.
This experiment cannot establish a safe corticosteroid combination in humans.

studies.label: Angiogenesis assays with a null finding

source.title: Modulatory effect of gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 on angiogenesis in muscle and tendon healing

studies.species: Male Wistar albino rats and endothelial-cell culture
sentences: Animal tissues showed changes in angiogenic-marker timing, while the cell-culture tube-branching assay found no significant difference.
These are assay-specific findings, with inconsistent concentration units reported in the paper.

studies.label: Rat Achilles repair and peptide combination

source.title: Effects of BPC-157 and TB-500 on Achilles tendon healing in rats: A histopathological and biomechanical study

sentences: BPC-157 alone did not significantly improve maximum load to failure versus control; the combination showed no additional benefit over monotherapy.
Only four tendons per group contributed to each endpoint, so nonsignificance does not prove no effect.

studies.label: Endothelial-cell mechanism · Reporting discrepancies

source.title: BPC157 drives angiogenesis through FBXO22-dependent stabilization of BACH1

studies.species: Human endothelial-cell cultures and rodent tissue-injury models
sentences: The paper reports endothelial-cell tube formation and an FBXO22/BACH1 mechanism.
Conflicting animal routes, doses and sample descriptions prevent a reliable animal dose–response interpretation here.

studies.label: Rat gastric-ulcer models

source.title: Protective effects of pentadecapeptide BPC 157 on gastric ulcer in rats

sentences: BPC-157 reduced ulcer area in chemically or surgically induced rat gastric-injury models.
The paper contains inconsistent comparator dose units and does not establish benefit for human digestive conditions.

studies.label: Rat retinal injury

source.title: BPC 157 as a Therapy for Retinal Ischemia Induced by Retrobulbar Application of L-NAME in Rats

sentences: The investigators reported preservation of retinal layers after L-NAME-induced injury in rats.
This experimental eye-injection model does not establish human visual or neurological benefit.

studies.label: Rat pulmonary hypertension

source.title: Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Therapy for Monocrotaline-Induced Pulmonary Hypertension in Rats Leads to Prevention and Reversal

sentences: The investigators reported improvements after early and delayed treatment in monocrotaline-induced pulmonary hypertension.
The findings do not establish a treatment for human pulmonary hypertension.

studies.label: Rat intestinal-vessel occlusion

source.title: Occluded Superior Mesenteric Artery and Vein. Therapy with the Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157

sentences: The investigators reported collateral-vessel recruitment and reduced pressure disturbances after mesenteric vessel ligation.
This acute surgical rat experiment cannot establish a clinical vascular treatment.

studies.label: Rat alcohol-induced gastric injury

source.title: Robert’s Intragastric Alcohol-Induced Gastric Lesion Model as an Escalated General Peripheral and Central Syndrome, Counteracted by the Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157

sentences: The investigators reported less gastric damage after concentrated alcohol injury in rats.
The thirty-minute model does not establish protection from drinking alcohol in people.

studies.label: Rat hepatic-vein outflow obstruction

source.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 resolves suprahepatic occlusion of the inferior caval vein, Budd-Chiari syndrome model in rats

sentences: The investigators reported smaller clots and less ascites after experimental vena-cava obstruction.
These results do not establish human liver-disease treatment or anticoagulant compatibility.

studies.label: Rat abdominal compartment syndrome

source.title: Stable Gastric Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Therapy for Primary Abdominal Compartment Syndrome in Rats

sentences: BPC-157 reduced pressure disturbances and organ injury in acute rat experiments.
The acute animal model and conflicting exposure-duration descriptions limit interpretation.

studies.label: Rat aortic-tissue spectroscopy

source.title: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy Reveals Molecular Changes in Blood Vessels of Rats Treated with Pentadecapeptide BPC 157

sentences: Aortic tissue spectra differed between treated and control rats.
This exploratory study used five animals per group; multiple tissue sections were technical samples, not additional animals.
